description.value: Angela's B&B is self-described as Rossland's original bed and breakfast, a long-standing establishment in this mountain town well known for cycling. Rossland sits at the confluence of popular Kootenay touring routes and is home to extensive trail networks, making it a natural overnight stop for touring and mountain cyclists alike. The property is centrally located on Spokane Street within the compact town core.
